cohort: Adolescents aged 10-19 years with type 2 diabetes who had adverse events reported to the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) related to metformin use.
finding: The study revealed a complex safety profile of metformin in adolescents with type 2 diabetes, identifying significant signals for congenital, familial, and genetic disorders, pregnancy conditions, treatment noncompliance, lactic acidosis, and gastrointestinal disorders, along with sex-specific findings and potential new adverse events.
followup_time: Data spanning Q1 2004 to Q2 2024 (20 years and 2 quarters)
